mapper.sql: SELECT t.schedule_id, t.schedule_date, t.employee_id, t.employee_name, t.employee_no, t.org_id, t.shift_id, t.shift_name, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name AS org_name FROM biz_hr_schedule t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.org_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.schedule_id, t.schedule_date, t.employee_id, t.employee_name, t.employee_no, t.org_id, t.shift_id, t.shift_name, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name AS org_name FROM biz_hr_schedule t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.org_id = d.dept_id WHERE t.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND t.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND (t.del_flag IS NULL OR t.del_flag = '0') LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_schedule SET del_flag = '2' WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
UPDATE biz_hr_schedule SET del_flag = '2' WHERE schedule_id IN #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO biz_hr_schedule (schedule_date, employee_id, employee_name, employee_no, org_id, shift_id, shift_name, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES
(#{item.scheduleDate}, #{item.employeeId}, #{item.employeeName}, #{item.employeeNo}, #{item.orgId}, #{item.shiftId}, #{item.shiftName}, '0', '0', #{item.createBy}, sysdate(), #{item.remark})
